body:
# Cooper Is Modpack — Main Modpack A **carefully curated Fabric modpack for Minecraft 1.21.10**, designed to enhance vanilla gameplay without overwhelming it. ### **Short Summary** This pack focuses on **extreme performance, lush exploration, and immersive audio-visuals**. It transforms the world with massive terrain overhauls and structure revamps while keeping the core Minecraft experience intact. Whether you are building complex machines with Litematica or exploring the depths of Incendium, this pack provides a polished, modern survival experience. --- **⚡ Performance & Visuals** Built for high frame rates and a clean aesthetic: * **Optimisation Stack:** ImmediatelyFast, Sodium Extra, and Fps Reducer for smooth gameplay. * **Immersion:** Continuity (Connected Textures), Sound Physics Remastered, and Entity Sound Features. * **Atmosphere:** Includes the **Sparkles** resource pack for enhanced particle effects and visual polish. --- **🧭 Massive Exploration** The world generation is completely transformed across all three dimensions: * **Overworld:** Terralith (ReStoned) and ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Villages (CTOV). * **Nether & End:** Incendium and Nullscape provide challenging new biomes and structures. * **Structure Suite:** Comprehensive overhauls for Strongholds, Desert/Jungle Temples, Nether Fortresses, Swamp Huts, and Pillager Outposts. --- **🧰 Quality of Life & UI** Tools to make your survival journey smoother: * **Information:** Roughly Enough Items (REI), ShulkerBoxTooltip, and Enchantment Descriptions. * **Navigation:** Searchables, BetterF3, and BetterStats for detailed player tracking. * **Mechanics:** Right-click Harvest and FallingTree (Timber) to speed up resource gathering. --- **🎥 Creative & Multiplayer Tools** Perfect for builders and social play: * **Building:** Litematica with Schematic Preview and WorldEdit support. * **Social:** Voice Chat Interaction support for immersive multiplayer communication. * **Technical:** ReplayMod and Mod Menu for easy configuration. --- **🔗 Downloads** * [**Server Pack:**](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cooper-is-modpack-serverpack/versions) (Server Modpack) * [**Main Modpack:**](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cooper-is-modpack/versions) (This Modpack) --- None of these mods are mine; full credit to all of the developers. ---
📦 Versioning & Release System **Version Format** `X.Y.Z` Example: - `1.2.4` - `2.0.1` **Version Numbers** - **X (Minecraft Update)** — incremented when the modpack updates to a new Minecraft version - **Y (Mod Additions)** — incremented when new mods are added to the pack - **Z (Mod Updates)** — incremented when existing mods are updated with no additions or removals **Mod Lists** Each release lists its exact mod set and changes in the Versions tab if you're looking for that.
